Project Art Corporate · Since 2002

The studio for events a company can't afford to get wrong.

Project Art Corporate handles every corporate and institutional event Project Art Group runs that isn't a wedding — planned and produced end to end, from the first concept meeting to the last minute of the run of show.

How an event gets built

The same seven stages, every time, regardless of the event's size.

  1. 01

    Concepting

    Translating the brief into a theme, a flow, and a look.

  2. 02

    Budgeting

    Costing the event against what it actually needs to achieve.

  3. 03

    Vendor & Supplier Selection

    Sourcing venues, production, and talent.

  4. 04

    Scheduling

    Building the run of show and the lead-up timeline.

  5. 05

    Coordination Meeting

    Aligning every vendor and stakeholder before the day.

  6. 06

    Dealing

    Locking contracts and terms with every party involved.

  7. 07

    Event Day

    Full on-site production, start to finish.
